---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever building or editing any page of the Crumb & Co. home bakery website.
---

1. The brand name is "Crumb & Co." and the tagline is "Baked fresh in Lahore, every morning." Show both in the header of every page.
2. Tone of voice: warm, friendly and short. Speak to the customer as "you" and the bakery as "we". Use at most one exclamation mark per page.
3. Colours: page background #FFF8F0, main text #3B2A20, headings and buttons #C8553D, accent highlights #F2C14E, cards #FFFFFF. Use no other colours.
4. Fonts: headings in "Playfair Display", body text in "Poppins". Load both from Google Fonts in the head of every page.
5. Every page must have a header with the brand name and navigation links to Home (index.html) and About (about.html), and a footer with "© 2026 Crumb & Co. · Lahore" and the WhatsApp number 0300-1234567.
6. Write prices as "Rs 1,250": the letters Rs, a space, a comma for thousands, and no decimals.
7. Write dates as "Sat, 6 Dec 2026" and times as "4:00 pm".
8. Every phone number field must accept exactly 11 digits starting with 03. Check this before submitting and show a friendly error in red under the field.
9. Show menu items as cards, each with an emoji, a name, a one-line description and a price.
10. Use plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript only, with no frameworks and no build step. The home page is always index.html in the main folder.
11. Pages must work on phones: stack cards in one column on screens narrower than 600px.
12. Never use photos or images from other websites. Use emoji instead.
